t: AI Education and Knowledge: Mastery Tracker — Simple
name: AI Education and Knowledge: Mastery Tracker — Simple
title: AI Education and Knowledge: Mastery Tracker — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A tracker that models what a learner actually knows: each skill gets a probability of mastery updated by every response via Bayesian knowledge tracing. The tracker stops drilling a skill only when mastery probability clears threshold — evidence, not seat time.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Mastery update: prior 0.5, correct response lik 0.9, marg 0.6 = 0.7500 posterior. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Education & Knowledge + Knowledge Acceleration (Chapters 11, 45)
real_world_basis: Bayesian knowledge tracing is the deployed standard in adaptive learning platforms.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UEK Balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (standardized vs personalized) scored per learner from tracker data, with the 'universal education' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: define the skill graph first, calibrate item parameters on pilot data, then adapt.
math_note: Mastery update: prior 0.5, correct response lik 0.9, marg 0.6: 0.7500 posterior [verified]; Diagnostic item information at p=0.5: 1.0000 bits [verified]

math_check.label: Mastery update: prior 0.5, correct response lik 0.9, marg 0.6

safety: Pedagogy safety: mastery estimates inform teaching; they must never be used to label or track learners permanently.
how_it_works: Responses update per-skill mastery probabilities; the tracker picks the next item at the frontier of the learner's knowledge. The demo recomputes a Bayes mastery update and the information gain of a diagnostic item.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

t: AI Education and Knowledge: Curriculum Sequencer — Simple
name: AI Education and Knowledge: Curriculum Sequencer — Simple
title: AI Education and Knowledge: Curriculum Sequencer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A sequencer that orders learning for fastest durable mastery: prerequisites first, interleaving for discrimination, spacing for retention. It treats the curriculum as a graph and finds the path, not the pile.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Retention after 30 days, half-life 14 days = 0.2264 fraction. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Education & Knowledge + Knowledge Acceleration (Chapters 11, 45)
real_world_basis: Spaced, interleaved sequencing is supported by decades of learning-science research and deployed in tutoring systems.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UEK Totality assessor — curriculum coverage (taught vs mastered) as a computed ratio, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: map prerequisites honestly, measure forgetting on your population, then sequence.
math_note: Retention after 30 days, half-life 14 days: 0.2264 fraction [verified]; Sequence latency: 8 stages x 25 ms: 200 ms [verified]
safety: Learner safety: pacing adapts to the learner; the system must never punish slow mastery with reduced opportunity.
how_it_works: The skill graph feeds a scheduler that interleaves related skills and spaces repetitions by measured forgetting curves. The demo recomputes a forgetting-curve retention fraction and a schedule latency budget.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub

t: AI Education and Knowledge: Knowledge Gap Mapper — Simple
name: AI Education and Knowledge: Knowledge Gap Mapper — Simple
title: AI Education and Knowledge: Knowledge Gap Mapper — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A mapper that finds exactly what a learner is missing: it diffs the target skill graph against the mastery tracker and returns the minimal prerequisite set blocking progress. Gaps get names, sizes, and a fill order.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.2 = 13 samples. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Education & Knowledge + Knowledge Acceleration (Chapters 11, 45)
real_world_basis: Prerequisite-gap analysis is standard in curriculum design and placement testing.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UEK First/Last assessor — diagnostic entry (first gap found) and mastery exit (last gap closed) logged per learner journey, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: build the target graph with teachers, validate gaps against independent tests, then fill in order.
math_note: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.2: 13 samples [verified]; Quorum for 5-teacher gap validation panel: 3 votes [verified]

math_check.label: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.2

safety: Assessment safety: gap diagnoses are starting points for teaching, not verdicts on ability.
how_it_works: Target graph minus mastered graph yields the gap set; the mapper topologically sorts it into a fill sequence. The demo recomputes the audit sample size for validating gap diagnoses.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

[REAL ENGINEERING] A mapper that finds exactly what a learner is missing: it diffs the target skill graph against the mastery tracker and returns the minimal prerequisite set blocking progress. Gaps get names, sizes, and a fill order.

Compounding view. Headline number: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.2 = 13 samples. This tier combines the mechanism with its limits: what is real engineering today, what the Signature version adds, and where the boundary sits.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Education & Knowledge + Knowledge Acceleration (Chapters 11, 45)
real_world_basis: Prerequisite-gap analysis is standard in curriculum design and placement testing.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UEK First/Last assessor — diagnostic entry (first gap found) and mastery exit (last gap closed) logged per learner journey, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: build the target graph with teachers, validate gaps against independent tests, then fill in order.
math_note: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.2: 13 samples [verified]; Quorum for 5-teacher gap validation panel: 3 votes [verified]

math_check.label: Audit sample for 95% confidence at p=0.2

safety: Assessment safety: gap diagnoses are starting points for teaching, not verdicts on ability.
how_it_works: Target graph minus mastered graph yields the gap set; the mapper topologically sorts it into a fill sequence. The demo recomputes the audit sample size for validating gap diagnoses.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

t: AI Education and Knowledge: Spaced Repetition Engine — Simple
name: AI Education and Knowledge: Spaced Repetition Engine — Simple
title: AI Education and Knowledge: Spaced Repetition Engine — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] An engine that schedules reviews at the moment of maximum memory value: each item's interval grows with successful recall and shrinks with failure, following the learner's measured forgetting curve. Reviews arrive just before forgetting, never after.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Retention after 7 days, half-life 3 days = 0.1984 fraction. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Education & Knowledge + Knowledge Acceleration (Chapters 11, 45)
real_world_basis: Spaced repetition is one of the most replicated findings in learning science, deployed in flashcard systems worldwide.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UEK A7 assessor — all four axes from tracker data, with the 'knowledge acceleration' framing fenced as concept.
build_steps: Build: measure the forgetting curve on your items, set the retention target, and let intervals adapt per learner.
math_note: Retention after 7 days, half-life 3 days: 0.1984 fraction [verified]; Daily load: 200 items x 8 s each: 26.7 minutes [verified]

math_check.label: Daily load: 200 items x 8 s each

safety: Workload safety: cap daily reviews so the engine aids memory instead of manufacturing burnout.
how_it_works: Each recall updates the item's stability estimate; the scheduler sets the next review at the target retention threshold. The demo recomputes retention fractions and the daily review load.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
